verses.text: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,

segments.text: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,

verses.text: Can a man be profitable unto God? Surely he that is wise is profitable unto himself.

segments.text: Can a man be profitable unto God?
Surely he that is wise is profitable unto himself.

verses.text: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? Or is it gain to him, that thou makest thy ways perfect?

segments.text: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous?
Or is it gain
to him
, that thou makest thy ways perfect?

verses.text: Is it for thy fear of him that he reproveth thee, That he entereth with thee into judgment?

segments.text: Is it for thy fear
of him
that he reproveth thee,
That he entereth with thee into judgment?

verses.text: Is not thy wickedness great? Neither is there any end to thine iniquities.

segments.text: Is not thy wickedness great?
Neither is there any end to thine iniquities.

verses.text: For thou hast taken pledges of thy brother for nought, And stripped the naked of their clothing.

segments.text: For thou hast taken pledges of thy brother for nought,
And stripped the naked of their clothing.

verses.text: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, And thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.

segments.text: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink,
And thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.

verses.text: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; And the honorable man, he dwelt in it.

segments.text: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth;
And the honorable man, he dwelt in it.

verses.text: Thou hast sent widows away empty, And the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

segments.text: Thou hast sent widows away empty,
And the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

verses.text: Therefore snares are round about thee, And sudden fear troubleth thee,

segments.text: Therefore snares are round about thee,
And sudden fear troubleth thee,

verses.text: Or darkness, so that thou canst not see, And abundance of waters cover thee.

segments.text: Or darkness, so that thou canst not see,
And abundance of waters cover thee.

verses.text: Is not God in the height of heaven? And behold the height of the stars, how high they are!

segments.text: Is not God in the height of heaven?
And behold the height of the stars, how high they are!

verses.text: And thou sayest, What doth God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?

segments.text: And thou sayest, What doth God know?
Can he judge through the thick darkness?

verses.text: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he seeth not; And he walketh on the vault of heaven.

segments.text: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he seeth not;

verses.text: Wilt thou keep the old way Which wicked men have trodden?

segments.text: Wilt thou keep the old way
Which wicked men have trodden?

verses.text: Who were snatched away before their time, Whose foundation was poured out as a stream,

segments.text: Who were snatched away before their time,
Whose foundation was poured out as a stream,

verses.text: Who said unto God, Depart from us; And, What can the Almighty do for us?

segments.text: Who said unto God, Depart from us;
And, What can the Almighty do for us?

verses.text: Yet he filled their houses with good things: But the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

segments.text: Yet he filled their houses with good things:

verses.text: The righteous see it, and are glad; And the innocent laugh them to scorn,

segments.text: The righteous see it, and are glad;
And the innocent laugh them to scorn,

verses.text: Saying, Surely they that did rise up against us are cut off, And the remnant of them the fire hath consumed.

verses.text: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: Thereby good shall come unto thee.

segments.text: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace:

verses.text: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, And lay up his words in thy heart.

segments.text: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth,

verses.text: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, If thou put away unrighteousness far from thy tents.

verses.text: And lay thou thy treasure in the dust, And the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks;

verses.text: And the Almighty will be thy treasure, And precious silver unto thee.

verses.text: For then shalt thou delight thyself in the Almighty, And shalt lift up thy face unto God.

verses.text: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he will hear thee; And thou shalt pay thy vows.

verses.text: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee; And light shall shine upon thy ways.

verses.text: When they cast thee down, thou shalt say, There is lifting up; And the humble person he will save.
